description: This file contains functions for optimizing and transforming Torch JIT graphs, specifically focusing on tensor operations like 'aten::cat', shape inference, and dead code elimination.

methods.name: moveCatAfterUse
methods.description: Moves the 'aten::cat' node after its user node in the graph to optimize tensor operations.

methods.name: numTensorInputs
methods.description: Counts the number of tensor inputs to a given node.

methods.name: doesCatPromoteTypes
methods.description: Checks if the 'aten::cat' node promotes tensor types due to input type differences.

methods.name: moveCatOpToEnd
methods.description: Moves 'aten::cat' operations to the end of the graph where possible.

methods.name: moveCatOpsToEnd
methods.description: Iterates over the graph to move all 'aten::cat' ops to the end.

methods.name: OptimizeCat
methods.description: Main function to optimize 'aten::cat' nodes in the graph based on configuration.

methods.name: annotateInputShapes
methods.description: Annotates graph inputs with concrete tensor types based on example inputs.

methods.name: removeUnusedSelfArgument
methods.description: Removes the 'self' argument from the graph inputs if it is unused and not a module.

methods.name: makeShapesSymbolic
methods.description: Converts concrete tensor shape sizes into symbolic shape representations within the graph.

methods.name: isGraphCompilable
methods.description: Checks if the graph is suitable for compilation based on input and node types.

methods.name: fixupTypeInfoForValue
methods.description: Infers and sets concrete type information for a value based on its node and context.

methods.name: inferScalarType
methods.description: Infers the scalar type of a node's tensor inputs if consistent.

methods.name: inferDevice
methods.description: Infers the device (CPU/GPU) for a node's tensor inputs if consistent.

methods.name: fixupMissingShapeInfo
methods.description: Fills in missing shape, dtype, and device info for tensors in the graph.

methods.name: removeGraphOutput
methods.description: Removes an output from the graph at a specified index.

methods.name: replaceListOutputWithTuple
methods.description: Replaces list outputs with tuple outputs for better graph representation.

methods.name: trimGraphOnce
methods.description: Performs a single iteration of graph trimming by removing unnecessary outputs.

methods.name: dequantizeResults
methods.description: Adds dequantization nodes after quantized tensor outputs.

methods.name: trimGraph
methods.description: Performs iterative graph trimming and dequantization for optimization.
